Episode 228. The Battle of Grosh Fortress (12)
A dark magic was leaking from the cracks in the crystal orb.
Sakiel was struggling to contain the escaping magic. When Jin struck his sword again, Sakiel stumbled backwards.
In that moment, Dante stabbed Rashid in. A sharp blade light pierced through Sakiel's back, spraying a deep purple blood.
[Khak!]
Just as Jin has the power of Eternity, a unique absolute power from his Divine Weapon, Dante also possesses the genuine skills left by Lon.
Hence, even if an enormous regeneration supports him, each of Dante's blows is fatal every moment. Sakiel bent over, his stance crumbling.
He instantly amplified his magic to deploy a protective shield, but it was bound to collapse under the next attack.
'Jin Lundell should have been exposed to Zito's magic directly when he struck my crystal orb.'
He had certainly seen Zito's genuine skills on the blade of Bradamante. That skill was sucking in the spirit and aura, the magic contained in the sword, like a leech.
There were also phenomena that did not appear externally.
'And Zito's energy should be infiltrating Jin Lundell's mind as well. But why does he seem to have no impact...!'
There's no sign of hesitation for a moment, no feeling of slowed movement. He didn't even furrow his brows or squint.

On the contrary, the momentum of his attack was becoming more and more fierce. Unlike just before, when he attacked mainly with sword energy to avoid direct contact with the magic, he continually invaded Sakiel's space, swinging his sword.
A typical knight.
No, even knights who have entered the realm of transcendence. Most of them would have been affected by the immense pain.
But Jin had already endured more severe mental attacks in the Demon God Temple. A mental attack from a demon that only borrowed part of Zito's power couldn't properly affect Jin.
"Where has your confident momentum gone, is this all you've got? Sakiel Grosh."
Boom-!
Sakiel was rammed into the inner column. As the ruins began to collapse, threatening to cover Sakiel, Dante's blade light, shot in a semicircle, struck Sakiel's neck first.
[Ugh!]
Sakiel reflexively touched his neck. If it weren't for Zito's genuine skills, his neck would have been cut off.
A calculation error.
From the moment the defensive line began to collapse faster than expected, Sakiel had been admitting that his calculations were wrong.
So, Sakiel chose self-destruction as her last resort, but now she was feeling an anxiety that surged like a flood.
What if her calculation for self-destruction through the field of loss was also wrong?
What if she ends up getting no results at all, and meets her death here at the hands of Jin and Dante's swords?
Such anxiety was rapidly confusing Sakiel's inner self. Even though she needed to concentrate on the fight, intrusive thoughts were creeping in.
In this world, no one could grasp victory over Jin and Dante while harboring distracting thoughts.
Screech-!

As soon as the gap increased, Bradamante cut off Sakiel's right arm. Super-regeneration to overcome eternity had begun, but until the arm fully returned, the flow of magic she could control was bound to decrease.
‘I can't go on like this. I must... regain my composure. I never fell apart like this, even when I faced numerous demonic gods and demon kings in the past.’
Fear.
The reason why Sakiel is freezing now is clearly stemming from fear felt from the overwhelming enemy, Jin. Fear was making her shrink.

‘Death is what I have already prepared for. As the Secretary-General of the Great Demon Realm, I, who is now guarding the entrance to the Demon Realm. I can't die showing only such a pathetic sight to my enemies!’
Sakiel, with her eyes wide open, faced the approaching two swords.
For a moment, she saw her own face reflected in the sword. Her pupils were no longer trembling and held a determined will.
In the split second that Bradamante was coming to cut her throat, Sakiel heard two voices.
‘Yes, like that, you should stand up once more upon despair.’
‘Sakiel, you must live! You too have to live, so we can meet again.’
Zito's voice and Paelito's voice.
Zito's voice was from the present, and Paelito's voice was from the past. It was a voice that came from the distant past she had forgotten. Sakiel accepted Zito's voice.
Swish...!
Bradamante brushed past Sakiel's eyes.
‘The atmosphere has changed. Is she finally prepared to die, or... has she been further corroded by Zito's energy.’
The magic transmitted through the tip of the sword had become more intense.
It was still Zito's power, not Sakiel's. Jin did not retreat, but pushed his sword deeper.
‘Regardless of how strong Sakiel becomes, she cannot be a match for Dante and me. Unless she suddenly ascends to eternity, never.’
In that case, what Jin still needed to care about was not Sakiel's atmosphere or martial arts, but the other strategies she had prepared.
Kwaaaaaaaaa...!
The walls of death, shrinking, caused Grosha Castle and its surroundings to vibrate. The walls of death had reached near the castle.

The screams of those running inward to avoid the narrowing walls, the noise of the fleet's power engines operating at maximum, the screams of those who could not escape and were sucked into the wall at the last minute.
Jin and Dante could feel all of this from inside the castle.

Fortunately, none of the members of the Union were affected by the wall of death. The wall of death started when the Union was at the 5th defense line, and the rest of the forces started fleeing from the 3rd line.
"Jin, at this rate, all the forces will soon enter the castle."
Jin nodded his head.
'Sakiel is deliberately gathering all the forces of the soldiers who were hitting the defense line....'

Sakiel, covered in blood, was firing magic wildly. With her newly regenerated right arm, she constantly created curses towards Dante, and with her left arm holding a crystal ball, she created offensive magic and shields to deter Jin. Dozens of dark magic circles were spread out behind her.
Also, Sakiel was showing a phenomenon peculiar to those who wield overflowing power.
Her physical body was collapsing, unable to withstand the power. Not only her regenerated right arm, but her entire body was melting and dropping purple fluid.
Jin was soon able to understand her intentions.
'I thought she was luring into Grosha Castle to massacre the soldiers with magic, but she was planning to self-destruct.'
There would be no reason to fight while destroying her own body if it wasn't for a suicide bombing. She should have been trying to keep her life in any way, thinking about what comes after.
As if to say, did you just realize it now, Sakiel smiled a crooked grin.

[Arrogance. You were too arrogant facing me. From the moment our defensive lines started to collapse, I was risking my life. But what about you? What about you, Jin Runcandel. Did you come here prepared to die while facing me?]

The vibrations and noise coming from outside the castle were getting closer and faster. The sight of Ziple's fleet charging into the castle to avoid the wall was visible beyond the collapsed castle wall. On the other side, the Union's forces, and on both sides, the forces of Kinselo and the Union, and Ziple were all entering the castle.

[You might think you won't lose your life facing someone like me, not even Zito. And maybe, that might be the truth. Jin Runcandel, Dante Highlan. After fighting, you two do indeed have a power that far surpasses mine.]
But will your subordinates out there be the same?
Sakiel continued her words, looking into Jin's eyes.
[I doubt it. Even if they avoid the wall of death, they will be killed by the magic laid here.... And you two will never be able to save all of them.]
Jin swept away Sakiel's magic circles with a flurry of upwhas while she was speaking. Whatever magic Sakiel had hidden, he had to kill her before it was completed.
However, Jin had an intuition that it wouldn't have as much significance as he initially thought.
"Sakiel is already in a state almost equal to death. Her flesh, unable to withstand the power of Jito, will crumble even if left alone.
So Sakiel has already made all preparations. Along with the Wall of Death, she's ready to spread the Field of Loss.
Jin doesn't know about the Field of Loss yet. Even if he knew, the magic circle for the Field of Loss has already been completed, so there's nothing he could do about it.
Sakiel thought so and clenched the crystal ball.
“You talk too much, you seem anxious."
Crash-!
The remaining buildings around them completely collapsed, and the forces of Inse entered the castle.
Only then did the Wall of Death stop shrinking.
[Master! Are you okay!]
"Jin! From now on, I and the knights will try to open the wall. So rest assured and finish him off!"
Voices of Faitel and Luna came through. The Golden Ship aimed at the Wall of Death and loaded its cannon, and Luna spread her red sword energy.
The flagships and superhumans of the other forces were also preparing to break through the wall and escape. In the chaos, Sakiel, confident that her plan had succeeded, raised the crystal ball.
[Whether you die swept away by magic, or forget everything and become an empty shell, you can't escape those two results!]
Roar-!
Suddenly, the inside of the castle brightened. Magic that looked like light magic, impossible to believe it was a magic of the demon world, began to emit a dazzling light like the sun.
The Field of Loss.
The greatest taboo of the Demon World was unfolding from Sakiel's hands.
'This is... Definitely dangerous.'
'I can't identify it, but my body is on guard. If exposed to this light for just a few more seconds, something terrible will happen...!'
Jin and Dante, who were closest, closed their eyes momentarily to a sudden intense ringing as soon as they saw the light.
Sakiel felt a thrill once more at their reaction. For the first time, the two men who had not even blinked at Jito's magic were reacting.
Even then, Dante rushed towards Sakiel and plunged Rashid into her chest. There was no solid sensation as her organs had already melted away.
And Jin was unfolding a magic with his hand raised.
"Sakiel, admit that it was my mistake not to kill you in time."
Inversion, the ultimate magic of the anti-flow system.
A huge magical sphere formed above the castle was seen absorbing the white magic that had consumed the entire Castle Groche.
"However, there's not only one way to destroy magic, and that's by killing the caster."
